title: NFL scrapped dual MNF games after concluding "fans felt like they were conflicted to choose"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFL scrapped dual MNF games after concluding "fans felt like they were conflicted to choose"
sources.description: For the last few seasons, the NFL has had several instances of broadcasting two Monday Night Football games on ABC and ESPN at the same time as part of the broadcast deal that increased Disney's total number of games per season.
